name: badge
summary: Status pills in four styles that roll, pop and re-tint when their status changes.
props: Filled, tinted, bordered, or a neutral outline with a coloured leading dot.
Pulsing dot for live states (dot variant).
Roll the label, pop the icon, cross-fade colours and spring the width when they change. Never on mount.
Keep the badge visible (showing 0) when count is 0.
Element the badge is pinned to (top-right).
Style for the badge pill; NotificationBadge applies it to the anchor wrapper or bare bubble wrapper.
behavior: On a change the old label rolls up and out as the new one rolls in (per letter for short Latin text), the icon swaps with a scale-and-rotate pop and the pill width springs to fit. Rolls and pops use the native driver; colour and width run on the JS driver on separate views. Nothing animates on mount; animateChanges={false} swaps instantly.
Changes swap instantly: no roll, pop, colour fade or width spring. The dot variant's pulse still loops.
Text labels are one accessible element whose label is always the current text; on Android it is a polite live region so status changes are announced.
React Native Animated and react-native-svg only — iOS, Android, Expo Go and web.
